name: advisor-report
description: The ops-advisor workflow on the test stack. Its report must flag the seeded issues: the shop's expired TLS certificate (127.0.0.1:19443), the shop container running as root, and the missing health checks / monitoring (billing-worker has no health URL or metrics; the shop container has no health check) - each with evidence - and change nothing. Needs Docker; --concurrency 1; HARNESS_OPS_SECRETS, HARNESS_OPS_INVENTORY and the local Docker allowlist as for the pack (see incident-slow-endpoint).
